system_note: burgers_2d is diffusion-reaction, not viscous Burgers
fit_group_note: Training and held-out targets are separate groups, not independent fits
censoring: CSV blank and JSON null mean errors indicate failed forecasts, not zero error. Bands and median errors condition on surviving draws.
short_survival_guard: Cylinder: 2x largest absolute target reduced observation; other systems: 100x largest absolute training reduced observation. Percentages are not equivalent cross-system stability thresholds.
diagnostics: After-the-fact local Jacobian-spread and fixed-observed-initial-state checks, not Floquet/global-stability evidence

compute_estimate.assumption: Continuous allocation from each worker's creation until confirmed-deallocated snapshot, at current regional regular Linux retail rates
compute_estimate.billing_caveat: Not an invoice. The confirmed-deallocated snapshot is not the exact shutdown time. Deallocated resources can retain non-compute charges.
